title: Winona vs Midi Health vs Gala: Online Menopause HRT Compared
description:
Winona, Midi Health and Gala compared on how the visit works, insurance versus cash, and how your medication arrives.

What we compared:
• Winona: dedicated to menopause and perimenopause; all-online intake with no video call; free physician consultation, pay only if prescribed; cash-pay; discreet home delivery in under 5 days
• Midi Health: clinicians trained in midlife women's health; video visits; hormonal and non-hormonal paths; works with many major insurance plans; medication through your pharmacy benefit
• Gala: 100% online telehealth visit; no insurance needed, FSA/HSA accepted, cancel anytime; free discreet 1-2 day shipping

Provider details as listed in our reviews (updated Oct 8, 2026). Insurance participation varies by state and plan.
